units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:4">Neg. II, 4</cite> <he>כיצד ראיית הנ׳</he> what must be the patient’s position when the priest is examining the plague (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:3">Lev. XIII, 3</cite>)? Tosef. ib. VI, 7 <he>כיצד ראיית הנ׳</he> what are the proceedings at examining a plague in the wall?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְגָעִים</he>, constr. <he>נגְעֵי</he>. Ib. 1, a. fr. <he>מטמאה בנ׳</he> is subject to uncleanness from house plagues. Ib. 7 <he>אין הנ׳ … לה״ר</he> plagues are the punishment for an evil tongue.
Neg. II, 5 כל הנ׳ … חוץ מנגעי עצמו. a priest may examine all suspicious plagues except his own; a. v. fr.—נְגָעִים the laws concerning plagues.
Y. M. Kat. II, end, 81ᵇ; Ḥag. 14ᵃ, v. אָהִיל.—N’ga‘im, name of a treatise of the Mishnah and Tosefta of the Order of Tohăroth, and of a section of Sifra (Thazri‘a and Mʾtsor‘a).
